subject: Security discovery recap: SOC 2 artifacts, bridge letter & portal access plan
messages:
From: Marta Alvarez <marta@clinicalsync.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: security@clinicalsync.com
Date: 2026-12-08T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Follow-up from demo — SOC 2 / bridge letter / evidence access

Hi Aditya / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo today — useful walkthrough and helped us understand how Redwood would fit into our workflow. A few items our security team needs to validate before procurement: 

- Copy of the most recent SOC 2 Type II report (or a summary if full report is restricted)
- Bridge letter or interim attestation if SOC2 report is older than 12 months
- Ability to access evidence via your Trust Portal (or an SFTP fallback) so we can verify controls and logs
- Answers to a handful of high-level DDQ items (we attached our short vendor questionnaire)

Can you confirm what you can share and a target timeline? Ideally we’d have the attestations and portal access within 7–10 business days to keep to our vendor review board cadence.

I attached the ClinicalSync security questionnaire for reference.

Thanks,
Marta Alvarez
Head of IT, ClinicalSync

Hi Marta — great to meet you on the call. TL;DR: we can provide a SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter; we’ll provision Trust Portal access and can also offer an SFTP upload if you prefer. Proposed next steps below.

Action items / timeline:
1) SOC 2 Type II report: We can share the full report under an NDA. If you need a non-disclosure channel, let me know; otherwise I’ll upload the PDF to the trust folder linked below by EOD tomorrow.
2) Bridge letter: I’m attaching a draft bridge letter we typically provide for customers awaiting the next Type II cycle — legal will sign once you confirm scope.
3) Trust Portal access: I can provision a ClinicalSync read-only account tied to your security@clinicalsync.com address. Please confirm the email and whether you need multiple reviewers.
4) DDQ: I reviewed the attached questionnaire. I’ll answer the high-priority items inline and push the completed DDQ to the same trust folder.

Proposed intake call: Wednesday 2026-12-15 10:00 AM PT (30 min) — use this Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/aditya-intake

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/192/deal/192-0192 | Trust folder (private): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-trust-portal-upload

I attached the bridge letter draft here for your review. If you’re comfortable with our plan I’ll loop in Jordan Blake on the legal side and complete the portal invite once you confirm the recipient list.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
